temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth denies being upset with Keith and says she is dealing with personal stuff; she apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believed Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly due to a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her denial and explanation shift his interpretation from possible anger at him to personal stress on her side.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and considerate, and perhaps offer support if appropriate.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers support and a coffee break; Elizabeth accepts and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is not upset with him and is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes/confirms; she is receptive to his support and willing to spend time with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth appreciates his support and is open to talking over coffee.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support through conversation or coffee and be available to her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about severe stresses; after Keith suggests professional help, she says she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is open to his support; Keith wants to help her through it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he learns her stress is severe and that professional help might be appropriate, but she is hesitant about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth's stress may require professional help, but she is hesitant; he must be careful and supportive if encouraging it.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, cautious, and somewhat worried about offending her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after his suggestion, then tells him he did not overstep and that she appreciates his concern, but it is a lot to think about.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; her initial withdrawal makes him fear he embarrassed her, but her reassurance changes that belief to thinking she is not upset and simply needs time to process.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth was not offended by his suggestion; she appreciates his concern but needs time to think.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful, then relieved and reassured, while still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her of his support, repair any discomfort, and avoid pressuring her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative; she thanks Keith and says his support means a lot and she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but needs time to think; she was not offended by his suggestion.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes/strengthens; her openness and thanks confirm that she values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable with him; their supportive relationship is stronger.
